observations.says: at nine o'clock on Monday, the office door was locked, with its lock not forced
the office door was fitted with two keys and no more
from six o'clock on Sunday until nine o'clock on Monday, Captain Dunmore was at Marlow
from four o'clock on Sunday until nine o'clock on Monday, Amos Trew was without the second key of the office door
at eight o'clock on Sunday night, Silas Finch had the second key of the office door, since the second key of the office door was marked with a brass tally
at eight o'clock on Sunday night, Silas Finch was at the quay
Finch said he never stirred out that night, and that cannot stand
